newsitem.title: USA: Total Renal sees likely meeting 1997 goals.
newsitem.headline: Total Renal sees likely meeting 1997 goals.

text.p: Total Renal Care Holdings Inc said Tuesday it is "reasonably confident" it will meet its 1997 projections because it added more than 1,800 patients in the second quarter.
The company also said its aggressive growth strategy in 1997 has caused its strong record quarter after quarter.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.33 compared to $0.22 for the same period a year ago. Revenues were $104.8 million compared to $64.6 million.
In addition, the company said it had 11 percent same store growth in the quarter. It said this was the result of its strong programs.
